t: You're looking at Caledonian Road station, on the Piccadilly line between King's Cross St Pancras and Holloway Road, in fare zone 2. It opened on 15 December 1906, run then by the Great Northern, Piccadilly and Brompton Railway. The building was designed by Leslie Green, an English architect. He is best known for a run of stations in central London in the first decade of the twentieth century. They are marked by oxblood red faïence blocks, pillars and semi-circular first-floor windows, with patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style. Look up at the front and you can see that signature.
